files.description: The house rules every change must follow: evidence rules, data safety, network and privacy limits, frozen signed files, and the changelog rule. The source of truth for what counts as a rule violation.
How the pipeline fits together (import, extraction, stance labelling, verdict rules, review screen, report). Read before judging whether a change breaks a data flow.
The merge rulebook: the Merge order section every PR description needs, the list of signed files, and when a changelog entry is required.
The format a docs/changelog/ entry must follow.
